turnaround_reason: A leveraged beauty roll-up whose Consumer Beauty division is in decline; the stock fell to ~$2.83 after management pulled FY26 EBITDA/FCF guidance amid a CEO transition and took a large impairment.
bullish_points: Early green shoots: CoverGirl and Sally Hansen closing the sellout gap vs market, Sally Hansen growing ahead of market; CoverGirl repositioned to Gen X.
Prestige fragrance remains a decent, low-to-mid-single-digit growth market where Coty is well positioned.
Optically low price and fwd P/E ~11 leave room if the turnaround takes hold.
bearish_points: Management PULLED FY26 guidance for EBITDA and FCF — a serious red flag mid-turnaround.
Consumer Beauty down ~10% like-for-like with a $362.8M impairment and widening adjusted operating loss (-$51.3M); company is unprofitable (-10% net margin).
Leverage is heavy (debt/equity ~98, EV ~$6B vs ~$2.5B market cap) — the equity is a thin stub on a lot of debt.
CEO transition adds execution uncertainty exactly when the business needs steady hands.
catalyst: Stabilization in Consumer Beauty LFL and reinstated guidance under new CEO.
suggested_trade: Pass for now / tiny speculative spot only; wait for guidance to be reinstated and LFL to stabilize.
key_risk: Consumer Beauty decline continues and leverage forces value-destructive actions.
would_skip_if: Guidance stays pulled or Consumer Beauty LFL doesn't stabilize — i.e., current conditions.
